roots.core_concept: a mark that stands for something / 一个代表某物的记号
roots.core_image: 在树干上刻一道口子，从此这棵树跟别的树不一样了

roots.core_concept: to seek, to ask after / 找、追问
roots.core_image: 翻遍抽屉找一件东西，边找边问它会在哪儿

roots.origin: 拉丁语 regere / rectus（引导、使直）
roots.core_concept: to guide straight / 引成直线、导正
roots.core_image: 沿着拉紧的墨线砌砖，砌出来的墙是直的

concepts.concept: a mark that stands for something
concepts.core_image: 树干上刻一道口子，这棵树从此与别的不同
翻遍抽屉找东西，边找边问会在哪儿
沿着拉紧的墨线砌砖，墙砌得是直的

words.root_logic: signum 本身即词根，无词缀 → 一个代表某物的记号；作动词是留下自己的记号
words.native_definition: a mark or object that stands for something; also to write one's name on something
words.core_concept: a mark that stands for something else – 一个替某物出面的记号
words.core_image: 路口立着一块牌子，牌子本身不是路，但告诉你路怎么走
examples: A road sign warned of falling rocks.
Please sign at the bottom of the page.
There is no sign of improvement yet.
semantic_expansions: 标志/迹象：替某物出面、让你知道它存在的那个记号
签名（动词）：把自己的记号留在纸上。同一个'记号'，一个是读它一个是留它

words.root_logic: sign（记号）+ -al（…的东西）→ 被发出来传递意思的记号 → 信号
words.native_definition: a sound, movement, or transmission that carries information
words.core_concept: a mark sent out to be picked up – 被发送出去、供人接收的记号
words.core_image: 灯塔一明一暗，远处船上的人照着节奏读出意思
examples: The signal is weak in this valley.
She signalled for us to stop.
semantic_expansions: 信号：被发出去供人接收的记号
示意（动词）：用动作发出记号。同一个'发出记号'，一个是物一个是动作

words.root_logic: sign（记号）+ -ify（使成为）→ 使某物成为某意思的记号 → 表示
words.origin: 拉丁语 significare：signum（记号）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: to be a sign of something, or to make one's intention known
words.core_concept: serving as the mark for a meaning – 充当某个意思的记号
words.core_image: 旗子降到半杆，这个高度本身就在说一件事
examples: A red light signifies danger.
He nodded to signify agreement.
semantic_expansions: 表示与意味着：都是'充当某个意思的记号'，一个偏主动一个偏客观

words.root_logic: as-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ sign（记号）→ 在某物上标记归谁 → 分配
words.origin: 拉丁语 assignare：ad-（朝向）+ signare（做记号）
words.native_definition: to give a task or thing to a particular person
words.core_concept: marking something as belonging to someone – 标明这份归谁
words.core_image: 每个座位贴上一张写好名字的标签
examples: Each student was assigned a topic.
The case was assigned to a new judge.
semantic_expansions: 分配/指派/布置：都是'标明这一份归谁'，中文按对象分了三个词

words.root_logic: assign（标明归谁）+ -ment（结果）→ 被标到你名下的那件事 → 任务
words.origin: 拉丁语 assignare：ad-（朝向）+ signare（做记号）
words.native_definition: a task given to someone, or the act of giving it
words.core_concept: the piece marked as yours to do – 被标到你名下要做的那一份
words.core_image: 名单上你那一行后面写着要交的东西和日期
examples: The assignment is due on Monday.
She took an overseas assignment.
semantic_expansions: 任务/作业：被标到你名下要做的那一份
分配（行为）：做这个标记的动作本身

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ sign（记号）→ 先把记号画下来再动手 → 设计
words.origin: 拉丁语 designare：de-（往下）+ signare（做记号）
words.native_definition: a plan or drawing showing how something will be made, or to create such a plan
words.core_concept: marking it out on paper before making it – 动手之前先在纸上把记号画下来
words.core_image: 图纸上先画好每一道线，工人照着线施工
examples: The design won an award.
She designs bridges.
It happened by design, not by chance.
semantic_expansions: 设计/图样：动手前画下的那套记号
意图（by design）：事先画好的那个打算。同一个'先标记好再做'，一个是图一个是心里的图

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ sign（记号）+ -ate（动词）→ 明确标出是哪一个 → 指定
words.origin: 拉丁语 designare：de-（往下）+ signare（做记号）
words.native_definition: to name or mark something officially for a purpose
words.core_concept: putting the official mark on which one it is – 正式标出就是这一个
words.core_image: 地图上被圈起来涂色的那块地，牌子写着用途
examples: The area was designated a nature reserve.
He designated her as his successor.
semantic_expansions: 指定/划定/命名：都是'正式标出就是这一个'，中文按对象是人、地还是名分了三个词

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ sign（签署）→ 把签过的东西反签交回 → 辞职
words.origin: 拉丁语 resignare：re-（往回）+ signare（签署）——原意'解除签署'
words.native_definition: to give up a job or position formally, or to accept something unwelcome
words.core_concept: signing the position back over – 把签下的位置反手签还回去
words.core_image: 把工牌和钥匙推回桌面那一侧，签下最后一份文件
examples: She resigned after eight years.
He resigned himself to a long wait.
semantic_expansions: 辞职：把职位反签交回
顺从/放弃（resign oneself）：把自己交出去、不再抗。同一个'反手交还'，交的是职位还是自己

words.root_logic: re-（反复、坚决）+ quir（寻求）→ 反复索要，非有不可 → 需要
words.origin: 拉丁语 requirere：re-（反复）+ quaerere（寻求）
words.native_definition: to need something, or to demand it officially
words.core_concept: seeking something insistently, as a must – 反复索要，缺了不行
words.core_image: 报名窗口一遍遍问你要那张证明，没有就办不下去
examples: This job requires patience.
All visitors are required to sign in.
semantic_expansions: 需要：缺了不行，非有不可
要求/规定：正式反复索要。同一个'非要不可地索取'，一个说状态一个说行为

words.root_logic: require（非有不可地索要）+ -ment（结果）→ 被列出来非满足不可的那一条 → 要求
words.origin: 拉丁语 requirere：re-（反复）+ quaerere（寻求）
words.native_definition: something that is needed or demanded as a condition
words.core_concept: a condition that must be met – 一条必须满足的条件
words.core_image: 申请页上那几行打勾框，每一格不勾就提交不了
examples: Meeting the entry requirements is essential.
Sleep is a basic requirement.
semantic_expansions: 要求与必要条件：都是'非满足不可的那一条'，中文按语境分了两个词

words.root_logic: re-（反复）+ quest（寻求）→ 开口去求的那件事 → 请求
words.origin: 拉丁语 requirere → 古法语 requeste：re-（反复）+ quaerere（寻求）
words.native_definition: the act of politely asking for something, or the thing asked for
words.core_concept: an asking put to someone – 向对方提出的一次索求
words.core_image: 递过去一张写着所需事项的条子，等对方点头
examples: Your request has been approved.
She requested extra time.
semantic_expansions: 请求与要求：都是'向对方提出索求'，区别只在语气强弱——request 比 require 客气

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ quir（探求）+ -y（名词）→ 往里追问下去 → 询问、调查
words.origin: 拉丁语 inquirere：in-（进入）+ quaerere（寻求）
words.native_definition: an act of asking for information, or an official investigation
words.core_concept: seeking into something to find out – 往里追问，把情况问出来
words.core_image: 一间屋子里逐个叫人进来问话，笔录越积越厚
examples: We received several inquiries about the job.
A public inquiry was opened into the accident.
semantic_expansions: 询问：随口往里问一句
调查/探究：系统地往里追问到底。同一个'向内追问'，区别在规模与正式程度

words.root_logic: quest 是 quir 的变体，无前缀 → 长途去找一样东西这件事 → 探寻
words.origin: 拉丁语 quaesita：quaerere（寻求）的分词形
words.native_definition: a long search for something important
words.core_concept: a long search undertaken on purpose – 特意展开的一场长时间寻找
words.core_image: 背包上路，为找一样东西走了很远还没到头
examples: Their quest for clean water took years.
He set out on a quest for the truth.
semantic_expansions: 探寻与追求：都是'特意展开的长时间寻找'，一个偏具体目标一个偏抽象目标

words.root_logic: cor-（com- 的变体，完全）+ rect（使直）→ 已经被理直了的 → 正确的；作动词是把歪的理直 → 改正
words.recall_hint: cor-（完全）+ rect（使直）→ 已经被彻底理直了；作动词则是把歪的理回直
words.origin: 拉丁语 corrigere：com-（完全）+ regere（引导、使直）
words.native_definition: free from error; also to make something right
words.core_concept: brought into line with no deviation left – 被理到直，没有偏差留下
words.core_image: 歪掉的画框被扶正，与墙边线对齐了
examples: That is the correct answer.
Please correct any spelling errors.
semantic_expansions: 正确的：已经理直、无偏差
改正（动词）：把歪的理回直。同一个'理直'，一个是结果一个是动作

words.root_logic: di-（dis- 的变体，分开、朝某处）+ rect（使直）→ 一条直线通过去 → 直接的；作动词是把人引上直路 → 指导
words.recall_hint: di-（朝某处）+ rect（使直）→ 一条直线过去，不绕；作动词则是把人引上那条直路
words.origin: 拉丁语 dirigere：dis-（分开）+ regere（引导）
words.native_definition: going straight without detour; also to guide or manage
words.core_concept: along a straight line, without turning aside – 沿直线过去，不拐弯
words.core_image: 两点之间拉一条直线，中间不经过别处
examples: There is a direct flight to Osaka.
She directed the project for two years.
He directed us to the exit.
semantic_expansions: 直接的：走直线不绕
指导/导演：把人引上那条直路。同一个'使成直线'，一个说路径一个说带路

words.root_logic: direct（直线的）+ -ly（副词）→ 以直线方式 → 直接地
words.origin: 拉丁语 directus：dis-（分开）+ regere（引导）
words.native_definition: in a straight line or manner, without anything in between
words.core_concept: with nothing placed in between – 中间不隔任何东西
words.core_image: 话从这个人口中传到那个人耳里，中间没有第三人
examples: Report directly to the manager.
I will be there directly.
semantic_expansions: 直接地：中间不经过别人别物
立即：中间不隔时间。同一个'中间不隔'，一个隔的是空间一个是时间

words.root_logic: direct（引导）+ -or（人）→ 负责带路的人 → 主管、导演
words.native_definition: a person who manages an organization or guides a film or play
words.core_concept: the one who keeps others on the line – 负责让众人走在那条线上的人
words.core_image: 片场上有人喊停，所有人等他说下一步怎么走
examples: She was appointed finance director.
The director asked for another take.
semantic_expansions: 主管/董事/导演：都是'负责让众人走在那条线上的人'，中文按场合分了三个词

words.root_logic: rect（使直）+ -ify（使成为）→ 使之变直 → 矫正
words.origin: 拉丁语 rectificare：rectus（直的）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: to put something right that was wrong
words.core_concept: making the crooked straight again – 把歪掉的重新弄直
words.core_image: 弯了的钢条被压回一条直线
examples: The error was rectified the next day.
Steps were taken to rectify the imbalance.
semantic_expansions: 矫正与纠正：都是'把歪掉的弄直'，中文按对象是物还是事分了两个词
